groups.title: Aluminum cut-off saws · value line
groups.lead: 16″ and 20″ pneumatic-clamping saws for aluminum profiles — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For the shop that cuts aluminum profiles now and then, the NovoTech value-line QCS-400 is a 16″ saw with pneumatic clamping and feed, and the QCS-500A a 20″ saw whose head swivels from 0 to 180° for profiles up to 10-1/4 × 5-1/8″.
